about: Reading JSON into records (DESIGN 5.23): `read Order from json text` and `read list<Order> from json text`, with `at "data.items"` to start inside. Every runtime fits what it reads to the entity before its own decoder reads the record: the text is parsed, `at` walks object names (dots between them), then each object is fitted to the entity's fields. A field is found by its name, else by its name ignoring case, underscores and hyphens (credit_limit, creditLimit and Credit-Limit are one). Fields the JSON leaves out, or gives as null, keep the record's defaults (`base`, a new record as Clarity writes it), and names the entity does not have are ignored; so is `id`, as the record is new. Each kind takes: text a string, a number or a bool (written as JSON writes it); integer a whole number or a string of one; decimal (and money) a number or a string of one, written as exact text; bool true or false; date a string of the date (a date and time keeps its date); datetime a string `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` or with seconds, a fraction of a second and a `Z` left out; enum a string of one of its values, any case; values a list whose items fit `item`; other (a reference, a picture, a file, a list of records) is never read. `fitted` is the record or list that results; `error` the message a reading that does not fit gives, word for word.
